discount.scopeProductId: productId is required for PRODUCT scope and must not be provided for other scopes
discount.scopeCategoryId: categoryId is required for CATEGORY scope and must not be provided for other scopes
discount.scopeCustomerId: customerId is required for CUSTOMER scope and must not be provided for other scopes
discount.percentageExceeds100: Percentage discount value cannot be greater than 100

notification.userIdsRequired: userIds required when targetType is USER
notification.targetRoleRequired: targetRole required when targetType is ROLE

loyalty.atLeastOneField: At least one field must be provided

common.csvMinRows: CSV file must contain at least one product row
